item.title: Analysis: Court Decision Marks De Facto Ban On Nicotine Vape
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
The court ruling means that liquid nicotine stays in the Poisons List because it was never (legally) removed in the first place. Hence there's now a de facto ban on nicotine vape: sales and tax collection became illegal instantly upon the court's decision.
